description: This file defines the custom exception class SignalEnrichmentFailedException used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate failures during signal enrichment. It includes constructors, static factory methods, and a builder class for creating instances with various contexts and properties.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentFailedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating failure during signal enrichment. It extends DittoRuntimeException and provides static methods and a builder for flexible creation.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentFailedException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of SignalEnrichmentFailedException with customizable properties.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the builder for SignalEnrichmentFailedException.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SignalEnrichmentFailedException from a JSON object, extracting relevant information like message and status code.

methods.name: dueTo
methods.description: Creates an exception instance based on a cause (another DittoRuntimeException), copying headers and setting description...

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance, copying current properties and replacing headers.
